senses.gloss: (Pilp. of בלל or בול; cmp. בהל) to mix up; to disarrange, upset, disturb.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 38b:9">Bekh. 38ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>תבלל</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 21:20">Lev. XXI, 20</cite>) <he>דבר המבלבל וכ׳</he> something which disturbs the arrangement (of the white and the black) of the eye.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:20">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>עמד ובלבל את וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>ופזר</he>) he upset the bridal canopy.
<cite ref="Sotah 46b:11">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בִילְבְּלָהּ</he> did not disturb the town (by pillaging, removing the inhabitants &c.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:5:3">Y. B. Kam. IV, end, 4ᶜ</cite> one struck him fatally <he>ובא השני ובִילְבְּלוֹ</he> and the other came and made him senseless (accelerating his death).—Part. pass. <he>מְבוּלְבָּל</he>, f. <he>מְבוּלְבֶּלֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 22a:3">Succ. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>סוכה מב׳</he> a festive booth the covering of which is disarranged, v. <he>דָּבַל</he>. [<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 4:1">Pesik. R. s. 4</cite> <he>נתבלבל</he>, v. <cite ref="K00755"><he>כִּלְכֵּל</he></cite>.]
